Package decorations

Package decorations come as prizes when buying special diamond packages. Supercell usually offers three types of packages, usually only available for about a week:

  • A small decoration or five fences with 130 dia for US$/€5.49
  • A medium decoration with 275 dia for US$/€10.99
  • A large decoration with 570 dia for US$/€21.99

However, prices and the number of diamonds may change over time, and from one package to another. Decorations may also come back again later in other packages or end up in the shop.

The company also took part in some charity events with Apple. In this case, only the small package was available, and only iOS users could buy it. 100% of the proceeds from players' purchases went to the charity organization.

*A medium decoration with 275 {{Infoicon|dia}} for US$/€10.99
*A large decoration with 570 {{Infoicon|dia}} for US$/€21.99

However, prices and the number of diamonds may change over time, and from one package to another. Decorations may also come back again later in other packages or end up in the [[shop]].

The company also took part in some charity events with Apple. In this case, only the small package was available, and only iOS users could buy it. 100% of the proceeds from players' purchases went to the charity organization.
